Source-assisted reading (research reader), made after the image-only first reading stams4-2026-10-31-image-only and with BSB Mapp. IX,205 e, image 22, in hand. Reread on the native images: the table on 1r and 2r, the Lienz area on 1r, the Rosenberger area on 1r and 3r, the lion and Venedig cartouche on 2r, the pencil notes on 2v and 3v, and bands of the offset on 1v and 2v, mirrored and contrast-stretched. Engraved lettering is given as on the plate; expansions are not needed. Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels. Uncertain readings (?), lost or unread letters [...], line breaks /.

Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-mzu8/Stams_STA_Frg_236_01r.jpg (canvas 0), ..._01v (canvas 1), ..._02r (canvas 2), ..._02v (canvas 3), ..._03r (canvas 4), ..._03v (canvas 5).

A. Table, 1r, canvas 0, 2940,5750,1972,1610
Jnhalt der Tirolischen / Landtafel. / 142. Herrschafften Gericht vnd / Hoffmärck. / 2. Hohe Stifft / 17. Stätt / 11. Märckht. / 5. Teütsche Heüser sampt der / Landt Comenterey / [48 Clö-, tops of letters only]
Note: the mark above "ckh" in Märckht is the ascender bar of k, as on the BSB sheet, not an abbreviation.

B. Table, lower lines, 2r, canvas 2, 4600,3150,1650,1050 (village figure at 4680,3850,620,250)
Landt Comenterey / 48 Clöster / 207 Pfarren / 1230 Kirchen. / 355 Schl[ö]s[er] vnd Sitz. / 894 Dörffer. / 15. Wasserflüss.
Note: holes through "Pfarren", "Kirchen" and "Schlöser". The first figure of the village count is 8 in the contrast-stretched crop (first reading: 3).

C. Place names, Lienz area, 1r, canvas 0, 3100,1600,1812,2100
windisch Matray; Kalß; S. Petter; Kastan Schrott; Pompanis wisen; Kien burg; Peischl; Hersch Lientz.; Iselwasser So[...]; S. Johanes Im waldt; S. Paul; ober Lientz; S. Elena; Pamberg; S. Martin; S. Prugg; S. Andre S. Bartlme; Statt Lientz; Lienzner Klausen; Talerbach; trab; Nußdorff

D. Rosenberger area, 1r (canvas 0) and 3r (canvas 4), upper part of the sheet
Rosenberger zu der / Mullitz Perckhwerckh.; Glaurach; S. Andre; In virgen mairn; Seinz

E. Book and cartouche, 2r, canvas 2, 1800,2950,1000,1200
book: PAX EVA / TIBI GELI / MAR STA / CE MEVS
cartouche: Herrsch: Venedig / wegen Ladober
also on 2r and 1r: the cartouche Ritterpurg inn Kärndten

2v, canvas 3, 1050,4750,1100,800: bis 1565 / [Urbar?] des R[auchen]b[ü]ch[l?] / 1448(?)-1633 (1744?)
3v, canvas 5, 2150,1350,900,1350: bis 1565 / ... / R... - ... / 1408(?)-1744(?)-1633 / Hs 308
